about: Rival rules for the wrong answers WorksheetFunction rounds 60101 (probes 1 to 5) and 60102 (probes 6 and 7) and 60103 (probe 8) found, each prediction written before Excel answered (live Excel, 2026-11-24 and 25). The cases of one probe run in order in one macro, on one new book's sheet that tests/fixtures/worksheet_functions_more.json fills, so a setup stays for the cases after it; once with f typed As WorksheetFunction, once As Object. Each case clears M1, runs its setup, and reads its expression into v; a cell formula case reads M1 back. Answers are as that fixture's Show writes them, E and a number for an error raised.
